title: Brave Explorers’ Quest
moral: Friendship and courage help defeat challenges.

scenes.summary: Oliver and friends plan to explore a mysterious forest.
scenes.text: Oliver and his friends decided to explore a forest to protect their village.

scenes.summary: They face a river blocking their path.
scenes.text: They found a river and had to build a raft to cross it safely.

scenes.summary: They enter a cavern filled with puzzles.
scenes.text: They entered a cavern and solved puzzles together to move forward.

scenes.summary: They save the village and return as heroes.

story: Oliver and his friends explored a mysterious forest to protect their village. They crossed a river using a raft and entered a cavern full of puzzles. Working together, they solved challenges and faced a dark sorcerer. Using a crystal, they defeated him and saved their village. They returned home as heroes, proud of their friendship and courage.
